name: Unstructured Mesh Pixelization via Convex Element Containment
definition: A pixelization routine that transforms variable-resolution unstructured mesh values into an image buffer by depositing values through nearest-neighbor interpolation with anti-aliasing, decoupling the pixelization step from the underlying data model.
summary: Unstructured Mesh Pixelization via Convex Element Containment transforms mesh data into images using a geometric containment test that eliminates the need for consistent vertex winding order.
